mapper.select: select * from tea_community order by cb_no desc
select cb.*, m.* from tea_community cb, tea_member m where cb.m_no=m.m_no and cb.cb_category=#{cb_category} order by cb_no desc
select cb.*, m.m_id from tea_community cb left join tea_member m on cb.m_no = m.m_no where cb.cb_no = #{cb_no}
mapper.update: update tea_community set cb_view_count = cb_view_count + 1 where cb_no=#{cb_no}
mapper.insert: insert into tea_community( cb_no, cb_category, cb_qna_category, cb_date, cb_subject, cb_rating, cb_content, cb_view_count, cb_url, cb_file, p_no, m_no ) values ( tea_community_seq.NEXTVAL, #{cb_category, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cb_qna_category, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{cb_subject, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cb_rating, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{cb_content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, #{cb_url, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cb_file, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{p_no, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{m_no, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.update: update tea_community set cb_subject=#{cb_subject, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, cb_qna_category=#{cb_qna_category, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, cb_rating=#{cb_rating, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, cb_content=#{cb_content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, cb_url=#{cb_url, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, cb_file=#{cb_file, jdbcType=VARCHAR} where cb_no=#{cb_no, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.insert: insert into tea_response_qna( res_no, res_subject, res_content, res_date, res_view_count, m_no, cb_no ) values ( tea_response_qna_seq.NEXTVAL, #{res_subject, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{res_content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, 0, #{m_no, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{cb_no, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
